translations.english: Glory to You O Lord, glory to You.
translations.arabic: المجد لك يا رب، المجد لك.

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ.

translations.english: Praise God in all His saints.

transliterations.english: Esmou e-efnoti khen nee-ethowab teerou entaf.

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ.

translations.english: Praise Him in the firmament of His power.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen pitagro ente tefgom.

translations.english: Praise Him for His mighty acts.

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲛⲓϣϯ.

translations.english: Praise Him according to the multitudes of His greatness.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof kata epashai ente tefmetnishti.

translations.english: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet.

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲯⲁⲗⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him with psaltery and harp.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen oupsalteerion nem oukithara.

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ.

translations.english: Praise Him with timbrel and chorus.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen hankemkem nem hankhoros.

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲁⲡ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟⲣⲅⲁⲛⲟⲛ.

translations.english: Praise Him with strings and organs.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen hankap nem o-orghanon.

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲉ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ.

translations.english: Praise Him with pleasant sounding cymbals.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen hankimvalon enese tou-esmee.

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ϣ̀ⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓ̀.

translations.english: Praise Him upon the cymbals of joy.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen hankimvalon ente o-e-eshleeloui.

coptic: Ⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ.

translations.english: Let every thing that has breath praise the name of the Lord our God.
translations.arabic: كل نسمة فلتسبح اسم الرب الهنا.

transliterations.english: Nifi niven marou-esmou teerou e-efran emepshois pennoti.

coptic: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ̀ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.

translations.english: Glory be to the Father, and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

transliterations.english: Thoksa Patri ke I-i-o ke agi-o Epnevmati.

coptic: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.

translations.english: Now and forever and unto the age of all ages Amen.
translations.arabic: الآن وكل أوان وإلى دهر الداهرين آمين.

transliterations.english: Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon ameen.

coptic: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅: ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ ⲟ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ.

translations.english: Alleluia, Alleluia, glory be to our God.

transliterations.english: Alleelouia alleelouia: thoksa si o Theos eemon.

coptic: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ⲁ̅ⲗ̅: ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲚⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ.

translations.english: Alleluia, Alleluia, glory be to our God.

transliterations.english: Alleelouia alleelouia: pi-oou fa pennoti pe.

coptic: Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.

translations.english: O Jesus Christ, the Son of God, hear us and have mercy upon us.
translations.arabic: يا يسوع المسيح ابن الله، إسمعنا وإرحمنا.

transliterations.english: Ieesous Pi-ekhristos epsheeri emefnoti sotem eron o-woh nai nan.
